state.seed_assertion: When relying on the disproportionate effort exception for not providing privacy information, controllers must be able to justify this and take other measures to protect people's rights.

sentences.1: When relying on the disproportionate effort exception for not providing privacy information, controllers must be able to justify this and take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.10: But you must consult the ICO if your DPIA identifies a high risk and you cannot take measures to reduce that risk.
sentences.2: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.3: Processing personal data not obtained directly from the data subject, where the controller relies on Article 14.5(b) impossibility or disproportionate effort, requires a DPIA when combined with other criteria.
sentences.4: Invisible processing occurs when personal data is obtained from sources other than the data subject directly without providing Article 14 privacy information.
sentences.5: 'Invisible processing' occurs when you obtain personal data from somewhere other than directly from the individual themselves, and you don't provide them with the privacy information required by Article 14.
sentences.6: Invisible processing: processing of personal data that has not been obtained direct from the data subject in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort.
sentences.7: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.
sentences.8: Children are regarded as vulnerable because they may be less able to understand how their data is used, anticipate effects, and protect themselves from consequences.
sentences.9: Most obviously, children are regarded as vulnerable to the processing of their personal data since they may be less able to understand how their data is being used, anticipate how this might affect them, and protect themselves against any unwanted consequences.
